title: Santa Monica increases visible Police patrols at the Pier, Beach, Palisades Park and Downtown
description:
Santa Monica Police Chief Darrick Jacob shares an update on SMPD’s enhanced public safety presence in the Downtown area this week and through the weekend.

SMPD is deploying additional patrol resources around the Santa Monica Pier, Third Street Promenade and Ocean Avenue, building on its existing presence and commitment to providing a safe, welcoming environment for residents, businesses and visitors.

Community members are also invited to join SMPD officers for Coffee with a Cop on Thursday, Aug. 27, from noon to 2 p.m. at the SMPD Downtown Substation, 395 Santa Monica Place. Stop by, ask questions and connect with the officers serving our community.
transcript_text: How's it doing today, Santa Monica? [music] I'm Derek Jacob, your Chief of Police. I want to talk a little bit about our new deployment that we're going to be utilizing this weekend and this week after our recent string of events that we've had going on [music] in Santa Monica. We're redeploying our resources so that we're more visible on the pier, on our Third Street, and along Ocean Boulevard, and in our parks so that our [music] folks see us so you feel safe. And we understand that some of the concerns that the public is having, but understand your Santa Monica [music] Police Department is here and we understand that safety is our number one priority and your number one priority. Thank you.
